properties.local3d_tip: Auto uses Pixal3D. Choose TRELLIS.2 for complex or thin geometry.
Fast = quick preview, Balanced = recommended, Maximum = most detail (needs the most GPU memory).
Auto removes the background. Keep uses your image's own transparency.
High fidelity keeps all detail. Game asset caps polygons and textures; it re-uses the generated shape.
Auto looks for a face and picks Character bust for people; Object for everything else. Complex uses TRELLIS.2.

nodes.title: Auto: is it a person?
widgets_values: 1 if (a >= 0.5 and c >= 0.09 * d and (b >= 0.6 or c >= 0.35 * d)) else 0

nodes.title: Subject (resolved)
widgets_values: 1 if a == 2 else (0 if a == 1 else (2 if a == 3 else b))

nodes.title: Bust cut: last picture row kept
widgets_values: c if (d != 1 or b <= 0 or a + 2.7 * b >= 0.95 * c) else int(a + 2.7 * b)

nodes.title: Crop your cutout to the bust
Unsure about the subject? (Auto only)
widgets_values: 0 if c != 0 else (1 if (a >= 0.6 and (b < 0.5 or d < 0.09 * e)) else (2 if (b >= 0.5 and a < 0.6 and d < 0.35 * e) else 0))

nodes.title: Unsure: person without a clear face?
What it looked for
widgets_values: Looked for: a face (score {a:.2f}) and a person (score {b:.2f}); scores run from 0 to 1.

nodes.title: Framing text
widgets_values: Framing: cut below the chest, rows 0 to {a} of {b} kept, so the face and hands get more detail.

nodes.title: Hidden surfaces
widgets_values: Hidden surfaces (the back and the far side) are inferred, not measured.

nodes.title: Unsure: person
widgets_values: Not sure: a person, but no large clear face (it may be hidden, small or stylised). Auto used the Object workflow; choose Character bust to crop to the upper body.

nodes.title: Unsure: toy
widgets_values: Note: a face but no person, so this may be a toy, doll or statue. Auto kept the whole figure (Object workflow); choose Character bust to crop to the upper body.

nodes.title: Subject report (what Local3D decided and why)
Preset: remesh resolution
widgets_values: 512 if a == 0 else (768 if a == 1 else (768))

nodes.title: Preset: AO map size
widgets_values: 512 if a == 0 else (1024 if a == 1 else (1024))

nodes.title: Local3D
widgets_values:
## Local3D — Image to 3D

This graph is the official **Pixal3D & TRELLIS.2** workflow with a few Comfy Core nodes added for the app controls (Model, Quality, Background, Seed). The quality presets live in the *Preset* Math Expression nodes (generated from `data/presets.json`).

Diagnostic previews are muted; un-mute them to inspect stages. Upstream: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates (MIT).
